newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch says Q1 earnings were record.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch says Q1 earnings were record.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said Tuesday it reported the highest quarterly net earnings in its history in the first quarter because of robust market activity and the strength of the firm's franchise.
Merrill said it earned $465 million in the quarter, a 14 percent gain from the 1996 first quarter and up five percent from the previous record of $445 million in the 1996 fourth quarter.

"Our record quarterly earnings were the result of the strength and diversity of franchise geographically and by market segment, as well as robust market activity that prevailed through much of the quarter, before slowing in March," Chairman Daniel Tully and Chief Executive David Komansky said in a statement.
The company said total assets in worldwide client accounts reached a record $868 billion at the end of the first quarter, up $137 billion from the 1996 first quarter.
Merrill said U.S. and global first quarter market shares of underwriting of debt and equity were 16.1 percent and 13.2 percent, respectively, according to Securities Data Co.
Securities Data also said Merrill had a 19.8 percent market share of worldwide equity and equity-linked offerings in the first quarter.
